name: ship-tasks
description: Deliver selected Task Manager work and derive problem-first strategic explanations from bounded read-only context.

interface.longDescription: Includes two sibling skills. Ship Tasks delivers work through explicit $ship-tasks or natural language that names an existing Task or selected Task Manager scope. A delivery verb alone does not activate it. Its constitution requires sufficient evidence, truthful state, and a readable native comment before every meaningful lifecycle transition while leaving tools, diagnostics, and acceptance methods to the agent. Failure of one method does not make it mandatory or prove a defect. In Review distinguishes a contradictory Task, a proven defect, a genuine verification blocker, and proven success. Strategic Explainer turns established facts into a problem-first human explanation without taking status, authority, or execution decisions.
defaultPrompt: Deliver TM-123 to a verified terminal outcome
Create exactly one Task in Task Manager and immediately start delivering it
Use Strategic Explainer with an explicit problem to find strategic context and explain the current result
